description: A project has these packages installed: `left-pad` 1.2.0, `chalk` 4.1.2, `ms` 2.1.3, `ghost-pkg` 0.0.1, `debug` 4.3.4. For each, look up its published versions and find the highest stable one, where stable means exactly MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (ignore anything else, such as prereleases); compare numerically. A package is outdated when that version is higher than the installed one. Return a record with `outdated`: a list of records `name`, `installed`, `latest` and `bump` (`major`, `minor` or `patch`: the most significant component in which latest differs from installed), sorted by `name`; and `missing`: names of packages whose lookup failed with NotFound, sorted ascending.

capabilities.description: Lists every published version string of a package.
